notes.title: Big June 2021 Update
notes.content:
Big update for the game with three major changes.
1. A Strategy Guide with walk-through and maps has been added to the game folder.
2. The game has been changed so that now you can save in dungeons and towns (anywhere you can access the Menu Screen).
3. Achievements have been added.
